description: A message that is not a scam: no type, no tactics, low risk, and the explainer is a reassurance and a tip.

body.redacted_text: Hi, your parcel from the post office arrives tomorrow between 9 and 12. Reply STOP to opt out.

explainer.reassurance: This looks like an ordinary delivery notice. It asks for no money, no password and no link.
explainer.tip: If a message you did not expect asks you to pay or log in, check it here before you do anything.
